verdict.rationale: Bitwarden's documented TOTP sync keeps the Authenticator and Password Manager apps synchronized with codes you add or edit, and its importer migrates codes from other apps without re-adding each one. This implies tokens carry over through the account, but no doc describes a guided phone-to-phone transfer. Missing for 10: an explicit documented one-step new-device migration flow, confirmation that all tokens restore on a new phone after sign-in, hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an everyday user, moving to a new phone transfers all my tokens in one guided step

citations.quote: Once activated, the Bitwarden apps stay synchronized with any codes you add or edit
You can import verification codes into Bitwarden Authenticator from supported applications, allowing you to quickly migrate existing codes without manually re-adding each one.
it automatically produces the time-based one-time passwords (TOTPs)
